article.story: HARRISONBURG, Va. -- — Cliff Davis scored 24 points as James Madison beat Georgia Southern 82-66 on Wednesday night. Davis also contributed seven rebounds for the Dukes (17-13, 9-8 Sun Belt Conference). Preston Fowler scored 20 points and added 11 rebounds. Eddie Ricks III shot 3 of 3 from the field and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 10 points. The Dukes extended their winning streak to six games. Tyren Moore led the Eagles (15-15, 7-10) in scoring, finishing with 20 points, four assists and four steals. Georgia Southern also got 15 points and seven rebounds from Alden Applewhite. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
